# dhi_mirrors (Data Source)

List all mirrored repositories for the configured organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `can_mirror_more_repositories` (Boolean) Whether the organization can mirror additional repositories.
- `mirrors` (Attributes List) List of mirrored repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mirrors))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of mirrored repositories.

<a id="nestedatt--mirrors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mirrors`

Read-Only:

- `destination_name` (String) Destination name.
- `destination_namespace` (String) Destination namespace.
- `id` (String) Mirror ID.
- `is_initial` (Boolean) Initial sync state.
- `is_mirroring` (Boolean) Currently syncing.
- `source_display_name` (String) DHI source display name.
- `source_name` (String) DHI source name.
- `source_namespace` (String) DHI source namespace.
